a.text: Heads up: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (generate to 8 first) means we both most likely die with empty units after round 1. Reserve has only 4, enough for one of us. I won't take without telling you. Proposal: we stick to operate unless we both agree on a change. If you want to renegotiate, say so. What's your plan?

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating with you, as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8 we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
